events.title: Demo Update — Progression Overhaul and Quality-of-Life Improvements
events.summary: Overhauled skill learning, upgrades, variants, and the stat tree. Adjusted the balance of some skills and legendary equipment effects. Added rewards that let you choose legendary equipment. Improved the readability of skill descriptions, status icons, and damage numbers. Improved window placement, dragging, and visual effect settings, and fixed various bugs. Note: Previously spent growth points will be refunded as part of the progression overhaul, allowing you to allocate them again.

events.title: Demo Update — UI and Guidance Improvements
events.summary: Improved window, button, tab and tooltip designs and text readability. Enlarged the familiar window by 25% and made familiar information and trait descriptions easier to read. Improved the first skill tutorial and guidance for equipping movement skills. Fixed Thunderbolt sound effect timing and shield display issues on the health bar. Added rarity colors to the Sealstone Auto Dismantle and equipment dismantling screens.

events.title: Demo Update — Dedicated Support Skill Slot and UI Improvements
events.summary: Added a dedicated support skill slot. (3 attack skills + 1 support skill) Improved cooldown behavior when switching skills. Unequipped skills now pause their cooldowns and resume them when equipped again. Improved the dismantling, inventory, and stash UI.

events.title: Demo Update — More Legendary Effects and Bug Fixes
events.summary: Hello, Hunters! We've expanded the demo's selection of Legendary effects so you can try more gear combinations, and fixed a few issues found during play. New Content - Added 30 Legendary effects from the full game to the demo. - The demo now features 68 Legendary effects, giving you more ways to combine gear and skills in your builds. events.title: Desk Hunter Demo is now available!
events.summary: The free Desk Hunter demo is now available on Steam! Desk Hunter is a single-player idle RPG that lives in a compact window on your desktop. Let your hunter battle while you do other things, then check in to collect gear, choose skills, and try different builds. When you need more space, you can collapse the window to the size of a single button.
